mechanism: Phenytoin is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer that increases betamethasone metabolism, reducing its therapeutic efficacy; conversely, betamethasone may increase phenytoin levels by inhibiting its metabolism.
action: Monitor clinical response to betamethasone therapy and consider dose adjustment; monitor phenytoin levels periodically as betamethasone may increase phenytoin concentrations; adjust doses based on therapeutic endpoints and serum levels.
